title: Design: suits between parties, an agentic judge, appeal to the operator (decision 3)
description: Ratified 2026-10-21. Design only, no code. Builds on .harness/design-T-436-contracts.md.
acceptance_criteria: Writes .harness/design-T-452-courts.md, at most 5000 words, extending the case register (precedent.py case) to suits: claimant, respondent, contract, damages claimed in operational budget. Reuses T-436's file_claim (replay at filing; a refused claim writes nothing) and its objection that halts.

Notice: how a respondent that exists only while a task runs receives notice and answers, for example a notice task on the board addressed to its name. What happens when nobody answers within the window, consistent with PR-022 and PR-026.

Judge: a judge colegiado and plaza published before they are filled (roster.py charter and plazas). The judge is distinct from both parties and from anyone who sponsored or voted in a related deliberation; say how that recusal is computed given that roster.py eligible is a report and not a gate (PR-017). Give the warrant payload shape for the seat, UNSIGNED; nothing is signed.

Judgment: a signed verdict act (privileged, intent first), what it may order (a debit of the respondent's operational budget, per T-436 and the 2026-10-08 ruling), and the published record PR-060 clause 6 requires for each consequence.
Appeal: how a party appeals to the operator, what the operator signs, and what stays frozen meanwhile.

The three numbers the operator still owes: propose values, with reasons, for the objection window, the pursue-or-lapse window and the damages cap, in units that make sense for agents that live only while a task runs. Mark them unratified.
Identity: parties and judge act under the dispatch tokens of T-446; say what the design assumes until tokens are wired.
Attacks: false suits, collusive suits (both parties one principal under D-17), judge capture, suits as harassment. For each, what stops it or what residual is accepted.
A worker task list, not boarded. Every precedent clause cited is checked against its record file. Hand off to verifier.
